Mia: Heads up — PR #8347 (deps: bump open-source tokenizer -> v2.1) is blocking tomorrow's hotfix window, need 2x LGTM before 11:00 PT.
Tom: Reassigning reviewers: @Anika @Soren can you take a quick look? Small diff, should be fast.
Anika: On it, will review in ~30m.
Soren: I can do a quick pass now but will defer to @Anika for final ok. Any known test failures?
Mia: Local smoke passed. CI flagged a lint failure in one package: `tokenizer/formatting.js` line 42. I pushed a tiny fix to the branch (`fix/lint-tokenize`).
dev-bot: CI status: 3/4 checks passed — lint failed on `tokenizer/formatting.js`. Details: https://ci.internal/builds/175999/8347
Tom: We need clean CI + 2x LGTM to merge into the hotfix branch. No force merges.
Anika: Quick note: `normalize()` needs a null-check, left an inline suggestion. Otherwise looks fine.
Soren: Approved after re-run, left one nit (optional). :thumbsup:
Mia: Thanks — that's 2x LGTM once the lint re-run clears and @Anika marks approve.
Anika: Approved. :white_check_mark:
Mia: CI re-run queued. Requesting expedited test re-run from infra — @dev-ops?
pr-approver-bot: Merge gate status: requires 2 LGTM, all checks passing, no pending migrations. Current: 2/2 approvals (pending), checks 3/4.
dev-ops: Kicked off CI re-run with priority tag, ETA ~7-9min.
Tom: Reminder: cutoff is 11:00 PT. If we miss it, this goes into the next hotfix slot (48h). Trying to avoid rollback of other changelists.
Mia: Confirming there are no breaking semantic changes — it's a minor whitespace handling fix in tokenizer, exercised in canary build earlier today.
Soren: From runtime side everything looks good; bench shows <1% perf delta.
Mia: CI passed ✅, merging now after the 30s backoff window.
dev-bot: Merge executed: PR #8347 merged into `release-hotfix/2026-03-19` by automation. See: https://git.internal/r/redwood/pr/8347/merge
Mia: Thanks everyone. I'll monitor post-deploy metrics for tokenization errors and surface anything unusual.
Tom: Adding a short line to the release notes: "hotfix: tokenizer dep bump -> v2.1 (minor whitespace handling)".
Mia: Closing thread — ping here if any regressions crop up.
